'''Block 53''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] block within [[Section X]], a region of the [[Belsavis prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. A [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[containment section]] was located in the area.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Block 53 appears in Section X, a Daily Area added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.5.<ref name="TOR" />
